item.title: [AI Prompt Workflow] Dynamic Light & Palette Prompt System
item.description: The industry is craving granular control over AI-generated aesthetics, moving beyond generic prompts to specific visual parameters. This system leverages direct lighting cues and pre-defined palettes to achieve highly mood-driven, consistent visual output. | Fonts: Outfit Black + Inter Regular | Palette: #0A0A0A #FF5733 #FFC300 #DAF7A6 | Prompt: Generate a hyper-realistic portrait of a subject with an expression of thoughtful contemplation. Employ dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from a single, warm overhead source. The scene is bathed in a palette of deep crimson and muted gold, with subtle emerald accents in the background. Emphasize textural detail on skin and fabric. 16k, cinematic, volumetric light.
